title: Final Virtue
survival_class: Mostly Safe . / Fairly Secure . / Minimal Entity Count .
physical_identity: Windswept blue-lit grasslands under a perpetually overcast sky, centred on the ruined medieval Stormstone Keep, ringed by mountains where a tar-like Living Abyss advances.
scale_topology: Finite outdoor plain; safe zone ~13.5 km across; Stormstone Circle 1.6 km from keep; Abyss in surrounding mountains.
lighting_sound: No sun or moon; faint blue glow outdoors; keep interior normally lit; lightning exactly hourly (local clocks); never rains.

entities.name: The Blue Knight (Temperance)
entities.behavior: Hollow armor guardian; friendly; patrols perimeter, harms Abyss

entities.name: The Living Abyss
entities.behavior: Adaptive tar-like hazard; corrupts in 3 stages; avoids lightning

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Blue Knight; Living Abyss as hazard

entrances.quote: Paintings on Level 5 that resemble this level are the most consistent entrance

entrances.method: Follow pink butterflies; arrive at outskirts
entrances.quote: Following pink butterflies on forest-like levels such as Level 14 and Level 199 will lead to the outskirts of this level
Certain convenience stores on Level 82 will transport one here
Jumping off the roof of Level 104 's Fortress leads to this level

exits.quote: Falling into an Abyss Pool has a chance to send one to either Level 10.1 , Level 41 , or Level 88
No-clipping into a lamp in Stormstone Keep leads to either Level 4 or Level 5
Getting struck by lightning will occasionally bring one to Level 73
Crawling into the smithy's furnace leads to Level 611
Walking through this level's forest can allow one to enter Level 9.3

exits.method: Noclip into locked door in keep
exits.quote: No-clipping into a locked door in Stormstone Keep will lead to Level 381

signature_mechanic: Blue-lit plain with a central keep, advancing Living Abyss with three-stage corruption, hourly rotating lightning across 7 zones, and a friendly Blue Knight.
verticality: Keep with second floor and basement forge; mountains as backdrop.
conflicts_notes: Intro says never rains; journal mentions a storm with rain (TESTIMONY). Text says 24 strikes per day yet 28 strikes outside. Forest and graves appear only in journal/exits. Levels 27 and 29 are nav links.

key_quotes.quote: the level is illuminated by a faint blue glow
Memories are gradually lost in chunks
This discrepancy indicates that time dilation occurs on Level 28.
Level 28 is almost entirely devoid of entities.
the Blue Knight has not exhibited any signs of hostility
